_comment: Staging fragment for ONE stroller option. Copy this to <option-id>.json (filename MUST equal the option id in src/data/seed.json), fill it in, and commit ONLY this file + the image. Do NOT edit seed.json — the integration pass folds every fragment in and bumps dataVersion once. Mirrors the car-seat contract in ../../RESEARCH_PLAN.md / ../../SOURCING.md.
name: Human-readable model name (must match seed.json)
_tags_comment: Material/certification facets to fold into the option's tags[]. ONLY include a slug you can cite (record the source in sources[] below). Known slugs: flame-retardant-free, greenguard-gold, non-toxic, plastic-free, organic, merino-wool. Omit or leave [] if none verified.

verifiedAttributes._comment: Facts to fold into the option's attributes. These map directly into seed.json's stroller attributes and drive the summary-table chips + criterion evidence.
verifiedAttributes.tires: front / rear tire size + air-filled vs foam
verifiedAttributes.suspension: suspension system name (e.g. Independent dual, SmoothShox)
verifiedAttributes.adapterSystem: How car seats attach: 'One universal adapter (brands…)' vs 'Brand-specific adapters (brands…)' — name the adapter(s) + price if known.

notes: Anything the integration pass should know: discontinued/superseded listing, in-stock vs backorder, MSRP vs sale, over-budget, etc.
